title: Audioliterary Poetry between Performance and Mediatization / Audioliterale Lyrik zwischen Performance und Mediatisierung
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: This book critically examines how audioliterary poetry – poetry that is composed to be performed – is changing in the digital age. Its interdisciplinary chapters reflect on performative embodiment in live formats (such as poetry readings and poetry slams), inquire into the techno-poetic environments of experimental sound poetry and AI poetry, and discuss how performed poetry is circulated on platforms such as YouTube and Instagram.
